banner.title: cloudflare-tunnel
banner.tagline: Runs two cloudflared replicas that dial out to Cloudflare and carry public traffic to envoy-external, so public traffic needs no inbound port.

art.about: how public traffic reaches the gateway through an outbound tunnel
art.title: How the Cloudflare tunnel carries traffic

explainer.title: Outbound only, from the edge to envoy-external

steps.title: Token
steps.text: ExternalSecret cloudflare-tunnel-secret reads the tunnel ID and token from 1Password item cloudflare into a Secret the pods load as env.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Dial
steps.text: Each cloudflared replica opens QUIC connections out to Cloudflare's edge and runs the tunnel with its token.
steps.scene: two small connectors reaching out to a cloud

steps.title: Route
steps.text: The ingress config sends the wildcard hostname to envoy-external's HTTPS port, with the lab's external name as the origin server name.
steps.scene: a cable forking into two paths

steps.title: Resolve
steps.text: A CNAME for the external name points at the tunnel's Cloudflare host, so public names resolve to the edge.
steps.scene: a globe with a cable running to a gateway arch
